sentence: This project provides expertise in biostatistics and bioinformatics to help investigators design experiments, manage large volumes of data, and form hypotheses.
This project uses a microfluidic single cell sequencing platform to study how microbes and innate immune cells influence each other.
This project engineers nanoparticles that deliver drugs to pancreatic tumors and tests how they affect immune responses against the cancer.
This project studies in mice how brain circuits and the endocannabinoid system relate to behaviors linked to alcohol use disorder during abstinence.
This project tries to find out how lactate weakens the immune system after sepsis by changing B cells.
This project studies how T cells contribute to the vascular lesions that form in the lungs in pulmonary hypertension.
This project tests treatments that target membraneless protein granules formed by receptor tyrosine kinase fusion oncoproteins in cancer.
This project develops a drug delivery system based on RNA technology to carry nucleotide-based drugs into the eye to treat posterior eye diseases.
This project tries to find out how a gene in glioblastoma makes tumors resistant to immunotherapy that relies on T cells.
This project generates single cell and spatial tissue profiling data and sets up ways to process, manage and analyze it.
This project studies how growing T cells in very high glucose changes their ability to fight cancer in adoptive T cell therapies.
This project tries to find out which somatic variants and genes cause brain malformations and what they do in brain development.
This project studies a type of helper T cell inside tumors and tests whether removing it improves the immune response to immunotherapy.
This project uses a zebrafish model to study how gene expression in different tissues affects nerve and muscle development in Congenital Disorders of Glycosylation.
This project studies how selective forces shape the evolution of precancerous pancreatic lesions, using genomic and transcriptomic analysis of human tissue samples.
This project combines brain imaging with recordings from implanted brain electrodes to find how deep brain stimulation improves symptoms of obsessive–compulsive disorder.
This project builds a wearable device that measures brain activity in natural environments to tell when someone is intoxicated by cannabis.
This project studies how a host protein changes the outcome of Ebola virus infection and looks for ways to control Ebola virus growth.
This project tests two treatment strategies for glioblastoma tumors that have defects in a DNA repair pathway, using calcium channel inhibitors and existing drugs.
